reviews.comment: Circuits was made a lot easier than previous years. Exams were straightforward if not easy. It's flipped classroom, so watch lecture before going to class to not be confused. Labs were a constant struggle, and the reports time consuming. Mechanics and Circuits will swallow up your time. Make sure to get a good lab partner and friends to study with
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: 321 was a pretty hard class so the difficulty did not necessarily fully come from the professor, but I feel like he did not do much to make it easier on us. The labs often were badly organized/had faulty equipment/took too long to complete & resulted in bad grades on lab reports from TAs. The test was not curved even though the average was trash.

Dr. Carrell is one of the most fair and helpful professors you'll come across. Fair is not the same as easy, as the course material can be rather difficult. However, Dr. Carrell ensures that assignment expectations are known and that his students not only have the ability to complete, but also have the time to complete the assignments given.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Carrell ran a very organized class with well-outlined expectations for his students. This class is a bit more work than what is ideal for the (pretty brutal) sophomore BMEN semester, but each assignment reinforces a useful skill or understanding of resources available to BMEN students.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: In class you really don't do much, so most people just work on whatever assignments are due in that class. There usually is about one paper due a week, spend time making sure grammar is correct and you are following the rubric, because sometimes they can grade hard.

As long as you follow the rubric for each assignment, you should be getting a good grade in the course. He's not kidding when he says he takes off 10 pts for not having a name on the paper. The class is easy, there's just a lot of writing that you don't find in other classes. He gives you a lot of time to complete the work, so don't procrastinate.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This class is honestly just busy work and gave me flashbacks to high school. Nonetheless, just do the assignments because it most likely is going to be the only class I get an A in this semester. Travis is a really chill person who just wants to provide resources to us, but the class is so unnecessary for a college student.

He's pretty quiet and in class you can pretty much do whatever you want. Sometimes he'll call on random people tho so be ready. Also loves grammar so you will lose points on assignments if you're missing a comma or something dumb. Looks like Mark Zuckerberg
